title: Builder BLD-101: Frame, top bar and public-bytes ratchet

source.ref: Owner approval 2026-11-02: build the next-gen builder from the role and block contracts. BLD-101.

detail: B1 Shell, pass BLD-101 (spec: docs/EDITOR-NEXT.md#bld-101). Frame, top bar and public-bytes ratchet. Scope: components/builder/shell, lib/builder/state. Build: Full-window canvas, top bar (Space and page, surface switcher placeholder, ⌘K trigger, Publish). One editor state module; components hold no section state. Add the editor-bytes-on-public-render ratchet at 0. Done when: Flag off renders the current editor; Visitor bundle contains no builder module. Gates: tsc --noEmit and lint, vitest suite (required test job), editor-bytes-on-public-render ratchet, check:build-budget and check:shell-weight, check:render-path and render_path flag-off test, Pass probes, check:backlog, check:one-list, check:adr, check:id-collisions. After: BLD-002. Loop: build, validate, repair (3 cycles, classes in EDITOR-NEXT.md), record.

verify.evidence: Filed from the builder spec. The pass writes scripts/probes/builder/BLD-101.mjs, proves it fails before the change and passes after, and switches this row to kind cmd in the same PR.
